name: handwritten-assignment-generator
description: AI Handwritten Assignment Generator - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend

scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install:all
